shown.message:
Outline rev. 8 is pushed to the wiki, aligned with Brief rev. 9.

- **Residual wording:** the 11.0 term at k = 20 is now called the "residual (estimation + misspecification)". It keeps that name until known-truth synthetic runs at the same training size and k separate the estimation share.
- **Better inference:** the claim that better inference rather than better selection would lower the error is now a hypothesis. The paper carries it only if Table 3 shows an inference rule lowering the excess over the floor by more than δ_floor.

`idea-repo`#8 is answered, so I have nothing further to raise. `experiment-repo` has now recorded the common target set as a dated post-result deviation. I haven't yet looked at the rerun results. I sent no message.
